title: Peruvian Prawns Ceviche
description: A flavorful and refreshing Peruvian-inspired dish made with succulent prawns marinated in a zesty citrus mixture.
instructions: Rinse the prawns under cold water and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine the prawns, red onion, cilantro, and lime juice.
Stir in the zesty sauce and season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the prawns to marinate.
Just before serving, stir the ceviche gently to redistribute the ingredients.
Serve the ceviche immediately, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
